one_liner: A toolkit that gives AI coding assistants a structured set of skills for reverse-engineering software and authorized penetration testing.
buyer: A boutique cybersecurity or penetration-testing firm that wants to speed up its analysts' workflow with AI assistance.
business_use_cases: A penetration-testing firm uses it to accelerate authorized binary and reverse-engineering assessments for clients.
A security-training company builds a CTF or red-team training curriculum around it.
A malware-research lab automates initial sample triage using the AI-guided toolchain.

money_ideas.idea: Use it internally to cut engagement time, then market 'AI-accelerated authorized pentesting' as a premium service tier.

steal_this: This is a real efficiency tool for licensed security work, but it's strictly professional-services territory — build a business around authorized engagements only, never around the tool itself.
